name: Epoch Archive Studios
niche: Indian city histories: founding, rulers, wars, trade, culture, food, geography, strange facts

language.script: Devanagari Hindi, simple spoken Hindustani (avoid heavy Sanskritised or Urdu words)

hook.rule: Open with a curiosity question that lands within the first 5 seconds
hook.example: Kya aap jaante hain is shehar mein itni jheelein kyun hain?

voice.post_filter: old-radio audio filter (applied in ElevenLabs by owner)
voice.generated_by: owner, outside the session (paste clean narration text)
voice.notes: v3 treats [square brackets] as audio tags, so fact IDs are never in the voice file.
voice.how: v3, stability Natural, speed 1.1-1.15; paste shorts/<city>/<id>-voice.txt as one generation (line breaks = pauses used for timing); old-radio filter; save MP3 to assets/<city>/shorts/<id>/voice.mp3
voice.plan: ElevenLabs FREE plan (owner, 2026-11-27): non-commercial licence, attribution required. Every description carries the attribution line. Upgrade to a paid plan (commercial licence) or switch to edge-tts before monetising (YPP).

goal.tier_full: 1000 subscribers + 4000 public watch hours in 12 months
goal.tier_lower: 500 subscribers + 3 public uploads in 90 days + 3000 public watch hours in 12 months

shorts_template.status: DEFAULT for every Short/Reel (owner 2026-11-27, v3: new outro)
shorts_template.length: about 60-75 s (owner accepted 71-73 s on 2026-11-27): 150-175 spoken words, ElevenLabs speed 1.1-1.15
order: 1. HOOK (0-3 s): shock line or question, 5-12 words
2. BRAND INTRO (3-7 s): intro_line with episode ordinal and city. Always after the hook, never first
3. STORY: one idea per scene, 5-6 s per scene, every claim has a fact ID
4. MID INTERACTION (around 40-60%): one line that talks to the viewer (imagine / are you from / tell us)
6. COMMENT QUESTION: one question viewers can answer in a word or a number
7. OUTRO (owner 2026-11-27): two lines, always the same: follow_line, then city_ask_line. No next-story/next-city teaser
shorts_template.intro_line: स्वागत है, असली सीन के {ordinal} एपिसोड में। मैं हूँ सूत्रधार, और आज की कहानी, {city} की।
shorts_template.follow_line: ऐसी ही अनसुनी कहानियों के लिए, फ़ॉलो कीजिए।
mid_interaction_examples: सोचिए, आप राजा होते, तो क्या करते?
अगर आप {city} से हैं, तो अपना इलाक़ा कमेंट में लिखिए।
आपके शहर में भी ऐसी कोई कहानी है? कमेंट में बताइए।
comment_question_examples: आज {city} का किराया कितना होना चाहिए?
आपको क्या लगता है, सही या ग़लत?
आप किस शहर की कहानी अगली सुनना चाहेंगे?
shorts_template.host_character: SUTRADHAR, the wolf narrator, on screen in the brand intro, cut-ins, viewer lines, comment ask and outro of every Short; story scenes show people as people
shorts_template.intro_tts: स्वागत है... असली सीन के {ordinal} एपिसोड में। मैं हूँ सूत्रधार... और आज की कहानी, {city} की।
shorts_template.ordinal_rule: Episodes count every Short in posting order across cities (Mumbai Short 1 = पहले). Past 10: write '<number>वें', e.g. ग्यारहवें, बारहवें.
shorts_template.prompts: All prompts come from prompts/library.json; build files with: node tools/build-shorts.mjs <slug>
shorts_template.shots: one narration line = one shot; narrator_shots bank for the wolf's lines; people as people in story lines
shorts_template.follow_tts: ऐसी ही अनसुनी कहानियों के लिए... फ़ॉलो कीजिए।
shorts_template.city_ask_line: और कमेंट में बताइए, अगली कहानी किस शहर की हो?
shorts_template.city_ask_tts: और कमेंट में बताइए... अगली कहानी किस शहर की हो?

show.name: असली सीन
show.narrator: सूत्रधार (SUTRADHAR), anthropomorphic Indian grey wolf; prompts in prompts/library.json -> characters.SUTRADHAR; introduces himself as सूत्रधार
show.note: Show/series name used in narration. Channel name stays in 'name'.
